verses.en: The beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God;
verses.pt: Princípio do evangelho de Jesus Cristo, Filho de Deus.
verses.en_web: The beginning of the Good News of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.
verses.en_bbe: The first words of the good news of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.

verses.en: As it is written in the prophets, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.
verses.pt: Conforme está escrito no profeta Isaías: Eis que envio ante a tua face o meu mensageiro, que há de preparar o teu caminho;
verses.en_web: As it is written in the prophets, “Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you:
verses.en_bbe: Even as it is said in the book of Isaiah the prophet, See, I send my servant before your face, who will make ready your way;

verses.en: The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
verses.pt: voz do que clama no deserto: Preparai o caminho do Senhor, endireitai as suas veredas;
verses.en_web: the voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make ready the way of the Lord! Make his paths straight!’”
verses.en_bbe: The voice of one crying in the waste land, Make ready the way of the Lord, make his roads straight;

verses.en: John did baptize in the wilderness, and preach the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins.
verses.pt: assim apareceu João, o Batista, no deserto, pregando o batismo de arrependimento para remissão dos pecados.
verses.en_web: John came baptizing in the wilderness and preaching the baptism of repentance for forgiveness of sins.
verses.en_bbe: John came, and gave baptism in the waste land, preaching baptism as a sign of forgiveness of sin for those whose hearts were changed.

verses.en: And there went out unto him all the land of Judaea, and they of Jerusalem, and were all baptized of him in the river of Jordan, confessing their sins.
verses.pt: E saíam a ter com ele toda a terra da Judéia, e todos os moradores de Jerusalém; e eram por ele batizados no rio Jordão, confessando os seus pecados.
verses.en_web: All the country of Judea and all those of Jerusalem went out to him. They were baptized by him in the Jordan river, confessing their sins.
verses.en_bbe: And there went out to him all the people of Judaea, and all those of Jerusalem, and they were given baptism by him in the river Jordan, saying that they were sinners.

verses.en: And John was clothed with camel’s hair, and with a girdle of a skin about his loins; and he did eat locusts and wild honey;
verses.pt: Ora, João usava uma veste de pêlos de camelo, e um cinto de couro em torno de seus lombos, e comia gafanhotos e mel silvestre.
verses.en_web: John was clothed with camel’s hair and a leather belt around his waist. He ate locusts and wild honey.
verses.en_bbe: And John was clothed in camel's hair, with a leather band about him; and his food was locusts and honey.

verses.en: And preached, saying, There cometh one mightier than I after me, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to stoop down and unloose.
verses.pt: E pregava, dizendo: Após mim vem aquele que é mais poderoso do que eu, de quem não sou digno de, inclinando-me, desatar a correia das alparcas.
verses.en_web: He preached, saying, “After me comes he who is mightier than I, the thong of whose sandals I am not worthy to stoop down and loosen.
verses.en_bbe: And he said to them all, There is one coming after me who is greater than I, whose shoes I am not good enough to undo.

verses.en: I indeed have baptized you with water: but he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost.
verses.pt: Eu vos batizei em água; ele, porém, vos batizará no Espírito Santo.
verses.en_web: I baptized you in water, but he will baptize you in the Holy Spirit.”
verses.en_bbe: I have given you baptism with water, but he will give you baptism with the Holy Spirit.

verses.en: And it came to pass in those days, that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized of John in Jordan.
verses.pt: E aconteceu naqueles dias que veio Jesus de Nazaré da Galiléia, e foi batizado por João no Jordão.
verses.en_web: In those days, Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized by John in the Jordan.
verses.en_bbe: And it came about in those days, that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was given baptism by John in the Jordan.

verses.en: And straightway coming up out of the water, he saw the heavens opened, and the Spirit like a dove descending upon him:
verses.pt: E logo, quando saía da água, viu os céus se abrirem, e o Espírito, qual pomba, a descer sobre ele;
verses.en_web: Immediately coming up from the water, he saw the heavens parting, and the Spirit descending on him like a dove.
verses.en_bbe: And straight away, coming up out of the water, he saw the heavens broken open and the Spirit coming down on him as a dove:

verses.en: And there came a voice from heaven, saying, Thou art my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
verses.pt: e ouviu-se dos céus esta voz: Tu és meu Filho amado; em ti me comprazo.
verses.en_web: A voice came out of the sky, “You are my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”
verses.en_bbe: And a voice came out of heaven, You are my dearly loved Son, with whom I am well pleased.

verses.en: And immediately the Spirit driveth him into the wilderness.
verses.pt: Imediatamente o Espírito o impeliu para o deserto.
verses.en_web: Immediately the Spirit drove him out into the wilderness.
verses.en_bbe: And straight away the Spirit sent him out into the waste land.

verses.en: And he was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted of Satan; and was with the wild beasts; and the angels ministered unto him.
verses.pt: E esteve no deserto quarenta dias sentado tentado por Satanás; estava entre as feras, e os anjos o serviam.
verses.en_web: He was there in the wilderness forty days tempted by Satan. He was with the wild animals; and the angels were serving him.
verses.en_bbe: And he was in the waste land for forty days, being tested by Satan; and he was with the beasts; and the angels took care of him.

verses.en: Now after that John was put in prison, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the gospel of the kingdom of God,
verses.pt: Ora, depois que João foi entregue, veio Jesus para a Galiléia pregando o evangelho de Deus
verses.en_web: Now after John was taken into custody, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the Good News of God’s Kingdom,
verses.en_bbe: Now after John had been put in prison, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the good news of God,

verses.en: And saying, The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand: repent ye, and believe the gospel.
verses.pt: e dizendo: O tempo está cumprido, e é chegado o reino de Deus. Arrependei-vos, e crede no evangelho.
verses.en_web: and saying, “The time is fulfilled, and God’s Kingdom is at hand! Repent, and believe in the Good News.”
verses.en_bbe: And saying, The time has come, and the kingdom of God is near: let your hearts be turned from sin and have faith in the good news.

verses.en: Now as he walked by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew his brother casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.
verses.pt: E, andando junto do mar da Galiléia, viu a Simão, e a André, irmão de Simão, os quais lançavam a rede ao mar, pois eram pescadores.
verses.en_web: Passing along by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew the brother of Simon casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen.
verses.en_bbe: And going by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon, and Andrew, the brother of Simon, putting a net into the sea: for they were fishermen.

verses.en: And Jesus said unto them, Come ye after me, and I will make you to become fishers of men.
verses.pt: Disse-lhes Jesus: Vinde após mim, e eu farei que vos torneis pescadores de homens.
verses.en_web: Jesus said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you into fishers for men.”
verses.en_bbe: And Jesus said to them, Come after me, and I will make you fishers of men.

verses.en: And straightway they forsook their nets, and followed him.
verses.pt: Então eles, deixando imediatamente as suas redes, o seguiram.
verses.en_web: Immediately they left their nets, and followed him.
verses.en_bbe: And they went straight from their nets, and came after him.

verses.en: And when he had gone a little farther thence, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who also were in the ship mending their nets.
verses.pt: E ele, passando um pouco adiante, viu Tiago, filho de Zebedeu, e João, seu irmão, que estavam no barco, consertando as redes,
verses.en_web: Going on a little further from there, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John, his brother, who were also in the boat mending the nets.
verses.en_bbe: And going on a little farther, he saw James, the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who were in their boat stitching up their nets.

verses.en: And straightway he called them: and they left their father Zebedee in the ship with the hired servants, and went after him.
verses.pt: e logo os chamou; eles, deixando seu pai Zebedeu no barco com os empregados, o seguiram.
verses.en_web: Immediately he called them, and they left their father, Zebedee, in the boat with the hired servants, and went after him.
verses.en_bbe: And he said, Come after me: and they went away from their father Zebedee, who was in the boat with the servants, and came after him.

verses.en: And they went into Capernaum; and straightway on the sabbath day he entered into the synagogue, and taught.
verses.pt: Entraram em Cafarnaum; e, logo no sábado, indo ele à sinagoga, pôs-se a ensinar.
verses.en_web: They went into Capernaum, and immediately on the Sabbath day he entered into the synagogue and taught.
verses.en_bbe: And they came to Capernaum; and on the Sabbath he went into the Synagogue and gave teaching.

verses.en: And they were astonished at his doctrine: for he taught them as one that had authority, and not as the scribes.
verses.pt: E maravilhavam-se da sua doutrina, porque os ensinava como tendo autoridade, e não como os escribas.
verses.en_web: They were astonished at his teaching, for he taught them as having authority, and not as the scribes.
verses.en_bbe: And they were full of wonder at his teaching, because he gave it as one having authority, and not like the scribes.

verses.en: And there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit; and he cried out,
verses.pt: Ora, estava na sinagoga um homem possesso dum espírito imundo, o qual gritou:
verses.en_web: Immediately there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit, and he cried out,
verses.en_bbe: And there was in their Synagogue a man with an unclean spirit; and he gave a cry,

verses.en: Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with thee, thou Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art, the Holy One of God.
verses.pt: Que temos nós contigo, Jesus, nazareno? Vieste destruir-nos? Bem sei quem és: o Santo de Deus.
verses.en_web: saying, “Ha! What do we have to do with you, Jesus, you Nazarene? Have you come to destroy us? I know you who you are: the Holy One of God!”
verses.en_bbe: Saying, What have we to do with you, Jesus of Nazareth? have you come to put an end to us? I see well who you are, the Holy One of God.

verses.en: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him.
verses.pt: Mas Jesus o repreendeu, dizendo: Cala-te, e sai dele.
verses.en_web: Jesus rebuked him, saying, “Be quiet, and come out of him!”
verses.en_bbe: And Jesus said to him sharply, Be quiet, and come out of him.

verses.en: And when the unclean spirit had torn him, and cried with a loud voice, he came out of him.
verses.pt: Então o espírito imundo, convulsionando-o e clamando com grande voz, saiu dele.
verses.en_web: The unclean spirit, convulsing him and crying with a loud voice, came out of him.
verses.en_bbe: And the unclean spirit, shaking him violently, and crying with a loud voice, came out of him.

verses.en: And they were all amazed, insomuch that they questioned among themselves, saying, What thing is this? what new doctrine is this? for with authority commandeth he even the unclean spirits, and they do obey him.
verses.pt: E todos se maravilharam a ponto de perguntarem entre si, dizendo: Que é isto? Uma nova doutrina com autoridade! Pois ele ordena aos espíritos imundos, e eles lhe obedecem!
verses.en_web: They were all amazed, so that they questioned among themselves, saying, “What is this? A new teaching? For with authority he commands even the unclean spirits, and they obey him!”
verses.en_bbe: And they were all greatly surprised, so that they put questions to one another, saying, What is this? a new teaching! with authority he gives orders even to the unclean spirits, and they do what he says.

verses.en: And immediately his fame spread abroad throughout all the region round about Galilee.
verses.pt: E logo correu a sua fama por toda a região da Galiléia.
verses.en_web: The report of him went out immediately everywhere into all the region of Galilee and its surrounding area.
verses.en_bbe: And news of him went out quickly everywhere into all parts of Galilee round about.

verses.en: And forthwith, when they were come out of the synagogue, they entered into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.
verses.pt: Em seguida, saiu da sinagoga e foi a casa de Simão e André com Tiago e João.
verses.en_web: Immediately, when they had come out of the synagogue, they came into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.
verses.en_bbe: And when they came out of the Synagogue, they went into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.

verses.en: But Simon’s wife’s mother lay sick of a fever, and anon they tell him of her.
verses.pt: A sogra de Simão estava de cama com febre, e logo lhe falaram a respeito dela.
verses.en_web: Now Simon’s wife’s mother lay sick with a fever, and immediately they told him about her.
verses.en_bbe: Now Simon's wife's mother was ill, with a burning heat; and they gave him word of her:

verses.en: And he came and took her by the hand, and lifted her up; and immediately the fever left her, and she ministered unto them.
verses.pt: Então Jesus, chegando-se e tomando-a pela mão, a levantou; e a febre a deixou, e ela os servia.
verses.en_web: He came and took her by the hand, and raised her up. The fever left her, and she served them.
verses.en_bbe: And he came and took her by the hand, lifting her up; and she became well, and took care of their needs.

verses.en: And at even, when the sun did set, they brought unto him all that were diseased, and them that were possessed with devils.
verses.pt: Sendo já tarde, tendo-se posto o sol, traziam-lhe todos os enfermos, e os endemoninhados;
verses.en_web: At evening, when the sun had set, they brought to him all who were sick, and those who were possessed by demons.
verses.en_bbe: And in the evening, at sundown, they took to him all who were diseased, and those who had evil spirits.

verses.en: And all the city was gathered together at the door.
verses.pt: e toda a cidade estava reunida à porta;
verses.en_web: All the city was gathered together at the door.
verses.en_bbe: And all the town had come together at the door.

verses.en: And he healed many that were sick of divers diseases, and cast out many devils; and suffered not the devils to speak, because they knew him.
verses.pt: e ele curou muitos doentes atacados de diversas moléstias, e expulsou muitos demônios; mas não permitia que os demônios falassem, porque o conheciam.
verses.en_web: He healed many who were sick with various diseases, and cast out many demons. He didn’t allow the demons to speak, because they knew him.
verses.en_bbe: And a number, who were ill with different diseases, he made well, and sent out evil spirits; but he did not let the evil spirits say anything, because they had knowledge of him.

verses.en: And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, he went out, and departed into a solitary place, and there prayed.
verses.pt: De madrugada, ainda bem escuro, levantou-se, saiu e foi a um lugar deserto, e ali orava.
verses.en_web: Early in the morning, while it was still dark, he rose up and went out, and departed into a deserted place, and prayed there.
verses.en_bbe: And in the morning, a long time before daylight, he got up and went out to a quiet place, and there he gave himself up to prayer.

verses.en: And Simon and they that were with him followed after him.
verses.pt: Foram, pois, Simão e seus companheiros procurá-lo;
verses.en_web: Simon and those who were with him followed after him;
verses.en_bbe: And Simon and those who were with him came after him.

verses.en: And when they had found him, they said unto him, All men seek for thee.
verses.pt: quando o encontraram, disseram-lhe: Todos te buscam.
verses.en_web: and they found him, and told him, “Everyone is looking for you.”
verses.en_bbe: And when they came up with him, they said to him, Everyone is looking for you.

verses.en: And he said unto them, Let us go into the next towns, that I may preach there also: for therefore came I forth.
verses.pt: Respondeu-lhes Jesus: Vamos a outras partes, às povoações vizinhas, para que eu pregue ali também; pois para isso é que vim.
verses.en_web: He said to them, “Let’s go elsewhere into the next towns, that I may preach there also, because I came out for this reason.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said to them, Let us go to other parts into the nearest towns, so that I may give teaching there, because for this purpose I came.

verses.en: And he preached in their synagogues throughout all Galilee, and cast out devils.
verses.pt: Foi, então, por toda a Galiléia, pregando nas sinagogas deles e expulsando os demônios.
verses.en_web: He went into their synagogues throughout all Galilee, preaching and casting out demons.
verses.en_bbe: And he went into their Synagogues in every part of Galilee, preaching and driving out evil spirits.

verses.en: And there came a leper to him, beseeching him, and kneeling down to him, and saying unto him, If thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
verses.pt: E veio a ele um leproso que, de joelhos, lhe rogava, dizendo: Se quiseres, bem podes tornar-me limpo.
verses.en_web: A leper came to him, begging him, kneeling down to him, and saying to him, “If you want to, you can make me clean.”
verses.en_bbe: And a leper came to him and, going down on his knees before him, made a request, saying, If it is your pleasure, you have the power to make me clean.

verses.en: And Jesus, moved with compassion, put forth his hand, and touched him, and saith unto him, I will; be thou clean.
verses.pt: Jesus, pois, compadecido dele, estendendo a mão, tocou-o e disse-lhe: Quero; sê limpo.
verses.en_web: Being moved with compassion, he stretched out his hand, and touched him, and said to him, “I want to. Be made clean.”
verses.en_bbe: And being moved with pity, he put out his hand, and touching him said to him, It is my pleasure; be made clean.

verses.en: And as soon as he had spoken, immediately the leprosy departed from him, and he was cleansed.
verses.pt: Imediatamente desapareceu dele a lepra e ficou limpo.
verses.en_web: When he had said this, immediately the leprosy departed from him, and he was made clean.
verses.en_bbe: And straight away the disease went from him, and he was made clean.

verses.en: And he straitly charged him, and forthwith sent him away;
verses.pt: E Jesus, advertindo-o secretamente, logo o despediu,
verses.en_web: He strictly warned him, and immediately sent him out,
verses.en_bbe: And he sent him away, saying to him very sharply,

verses.en: And saith unto him, See thou say nothing to any man: but go thy way, shew thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing those things which Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
verses.pt: dizendo-lhe: Olha, não digas nada a ninguém; mas vai, mostra-te ao sacerdote e oferece pela tua purificação o que Moisés determinou, para lhes servir de testemunho.
verses.en_web: and said to him, “See you say nothing to anybody, but go show yourself to the priest, and offer for your cleansing the things which Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.”
verses.en_bbe: See that you say nothing to any man: but go and let the priest see you, and make yourself clean by an offering of the things ordered by Moses, for a witness to them.

verses.en: But he went out, and began to publish it much, and to blaze abroad the matter, insomuch that Jesus could no more openly enter into the city, but was without in desert places: and they came to him from every quarter.
verses.pt: Ele, porém, saindo dali, começou a publicar o caso por toda parte e a divulgá-lo, de modo que Jesus já não podia entrar abertamente numa cidade, mas conservava-se fora em lugares desertos; e de todos os lados iam ter com ele.
verses.en_web: But he went out, and began to proclaim it much, and to spread about the matter, so that Jesus could no more openly enter into a city, but was outside in desert places: and they came to him from everywhere.
verses.en_bbe: But he went out, and made it public, giving an account of it everywhere, so that Jesus was no longer able to go openly into a town, but was outside in the waste land; and they came to him from every part.
